cfg["gamma"]=[.08,.06,.09,.07,.05] if len(cfg["u"])==5 else [.07]*len(cfg["u"])

angle=.37
axis=np.array([1.,2.,-1.]);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
K=np.array([[0.,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0.,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0.]])

cfg["velocity"]=(np.asarray(cfg["velocity"])@O.T).tolist()
# The step-1 correction acts on an exactly relaxed initial state, so its beta is
# round-off near the 1e-14 cutoff; exclude only that row's rank and error.
def _without_step1_kernel_stats(record):
    record = np.asarray(record, dtype=float)
    keep = np.ones(record.shape, dtype=bool)
    if record.shape[0] > 1:
        keep[1, 9:11] = False
    return np.concatenate((np.asarray(record.shape, dtype=float), record[keep]))
assert np.allclose(_without_step1_kernel_stats(shadow_trajectory(**cfg)), target)
